status: Research comparison notes only; no proposed/fixed taxonomy or scoring change.
known_outcomes: Published outcomes were known. Source observations and reconstructed decisions retain their original provenance in referenced files.

comparisons.observed_recurrence: Broader resemblance supports a retained capacity while a narrower property requires its own comparison.
comparisons.observed_variation: HemK: amino-group methylation versus protein/DNA substrate; TM0936: metal chemistry versus SAH/AMP specificity; YihS: related sugar chemistry versus sulfonate selectivity.
comparisons.next_question_difference: A wider core comparison can repair weak motif evidence; a substrate-negative comparator can challenge an overextended specificity claim. These are different next choices.
comparisons.boundary_question: Does searching for a suitable analogue separate cleanly from deciding which property can transfer? Not yet established as independent slots.

comparisons.observed_recurrence: A positive association motivates an initially broad rule; a specifically chosen exception changes its scope.
comparisons.observed_variation: SAH activity despite absent arginines; OarX retained without a recorded FmnO partner; mature rnpB retained in Y-complex mutants.
comparisons.next_question_difference: Resolve alternative geometry, distinguish optional partner from absent annotation, or delimit dependent RNA substrates. The same exception-seeking move demands different biological interpretation.
comparisons.boundary_question: Exception selection looks reusable across tools; the response must distinguish an invalid rule from a narrower conditional rule.

comparisons.observed_recurrence: A failed reaction or reagent test rejects one mechanistic interpretation without automatically discarding a supported pathway connection.
comparisons.observed_variation: QueF cyclohydrolase negatives; MJ0044 phosphorylation-order alternatives; LhgO oxygen versus quinone.
comparisons.next_question_difference: Search a different pathway step, change reaction order, or replace an assumed electron acceptor.
comparisons.boundary_question: Revising one component of a hypothesis must preserve which other components remain supported; this is not simply a repeat-search task.

comparisons.observed_recurrence: Improved phenotype does not uniquely identify the repaired relationship.
comparisons.observed_variation: Complementary YabA interaction defects together restore localization/control; YihI improves derT57I growth without restoring its measured GTPase activity; YhcB suppressors modify other envelope pathways.
comparisons.next_question_difference: Test joint interaction requirements, separate catalytic restoration from compensation, or inspect broader balance.
comparisons.boundary_question: How should a process represent the proposed causal relationship so it requests a discriminating control rather than calling all rescue equivalent?

comparisons.observed_recurrence: Before transferring an observation, check which entity the record or measurement actually concerns.
comparisons.observed_variation: Host CodA versus expressed archaeal candidate; deposited 3RS8 ligand list versus paper description; OarX comparison table and experimental genome from different strains.
comparisons.next_question_difference: Follow activity across purification, inspect the cited entry itself, or preserve explicit strain mapping.
comparisons.boundary_question: This recurrence could be a shared provenance obligation rather than a selectable scientific thought-pattern slot; retain that distinction.

comparisons.observed_recurrence: A proposed role has a necessary unsatisfied requirement, constraining which missing function or component to investigate.
comparisons.observed_variation: Retained pathway before/after a missing kinase; repair of only one NAD(P)HX stereoisomer; disposal opposed by uncoupled reaction equilibrium.
comparisons.next_question_difference: Seek a nonorthologous replacement, a stereochemical partner, or an energy-coupled multi-component system.
comparisons.boundary_question: Necessary requirements can constrain similarity search or motivate an unrelated candidate; they are not a mandatory pathway-reconstruction stage.
